model: kind control-plane node: kube-apiserver, kubelet, etcd

capture.target: openmap-control-plane 192.168.96.2 on the kind bridge (the manager container joined the kind network for the capture and left it afterwards)
capture.command:
pscap (scratch Go tool performing internal/portscan Probe's socket IO: one 512-byte banner read with 1.5 s timeout and, when the service stays silent, a second connection attempting a TLS handshake (InsecureSkipVerify; peer chain saved as DER on success); on HTTP ports write 'HEAD / HTTP/1.0
Host: <host>

' first; on TLS-first ports outside the web list (636, 6443, 10250) only the handshake, nothing written or read); run from the lab manager container fxlab-k-mgr (alpine:3.20) on the fxlab-k bridge: pscap -host <container> -port <port> -mode <banner|http|tls-silent> -name <port>-<service>

files.name: 10250-kubelet.banner
files.description: raw bytes the service sent (what Probe's banner read returns before printable()); empty when the service waits for the client

files.name: 10250-kubelet.chain0.der
files.description: peer certificate presented in the TLS handshake (DER), chain position in the name

files.name: 10250-kubelet.chain1.der
files.description: peer certificate presented in the TLS handshake (DER), chain position in the name

files.name: 10250-kubelet.json
files.description: capture record: host, port, mode, byte count, TLS outcome and error, chain files

files.name: 2379-etcd.banner
files.description: raw bytes the service sent (what Probe's banner read returns before printable()); empty when the service waits for the client

files.name: 2379-etcd.chain0.der
files.description: peer certificate presented in the TLS handshake (DER), chain position in the name

files.name: 2379-etcd.json
files.description: capture record: host, port, mode, byte count, TLS outcome and error, chain files

files.name: 6443-kubernetes-api.banner
files.description: raw bytes the service sent (what Probe's banner read returns before printable()); empty when the service waits for the client

files.name: 6443-kubernetes-api.chain0.der
files.description: peer certificate presented in the TLS handshake (DER), chain position in the name

files.name: 6443-kubernetes-api.json
files.description: capture record: host, port, mode, byte count, TLS outcome and error, chain files

notes: Nothing was written to any port: 6443 and 10250 were only handshaken (TLS-first ports outside Probe's HEAD list), and etcd's 2379 sent no banner, so Probe's TLS retry handshook it; the TLS 1.3 client handshake completes before etcd checks for a client certificate. Certificates are the cluster's own (public) serving certificates; no keys, tokens or client certificates were involved.
